# ALVA Developer Preview 2

This preview makes ALVA's semantic editing workflow directly available to
coding agents. ALVA remains an experimental, pre-stable programming system.

## Included in this preview

- **Canonical ALVA Skill.** A shared MCP-first, CLI-fallback workflow teaches
  coding agents to resolve, inspect, discover, stage, review, check, and commit
  semantic edits without treating `.alva` source as an ordinary text patch.
- **Shared `alva mcp` semantic server.** The installed `alva` binary now serves
  the same AEP/AIR operations over local STDIO MCP, with explicit transaction
  handles, structured results, legacy 2025 compatibility, and the stateless
  2026-07-28 request envelope.
- **Accurate `change_field` revisions.** Successful field mutations now return
  the newly materialized content revision rather than the historical input
  revision.

The release continues to include source checking, Rust code generation, native
and WASM/WASI targets, `alva doctor`, installation scripts, Windows x64, Linux
x64, and macOS Apple Silicon packages, plus SHA-256 checksums.

## Toolchain boundary

The prebuilt `alva` binary can check programs and provide its semantic MCP/AEP
interfaces without building ALVA from source. `alva build` and `alva run`
generate and compile Rust, so they still require a Rust toolchain. WASM output
additionally requires the `wasm32-wasip1` Rust target. Run `alva doctor` to
inspect these dependencies.

`v0.14.1-preview.1` remains an immutable earlier Developer Preview; no existing
release tag was moved.
